reviews.subject: numb_body_small
reviews.visual_notes: Two legs, no arms or human face; fused right-facing beak/head and two rear projections fit source. Pale veined skin retained, no blocking grey halo. Do not assign Medium/Large/Arcade.

reviews.subject: floatstinger_final

Alpha128 bbox1746x727=2.40165, vs initial1.64376 and primary source non-white bbox1599x761=2.10118 (source luma difference from white>50). Thus revision is about14.3% wider/shorter than source, not exact proportions. Upper/lower wing sweep and abdomen length remain reconstructed; static pose only.

resolved_findings.observation: The corridor image uses a front perspective with floor confined to a central trapezoid, while actors move on a horizontal versus baseline. At the captured left position Groaner paws are visibly superimposed on the lower left wall/plinth rather than carpet. Split Head occupies the right wall/floor edge.
resolved_findings.impact: Logical sprite anchors are consistent with grid checks, but the composite can look like the grounded creature is floating or attached to the wall. This is a source-frame/perspective limitation, not evidence of a physics or collision failure.
resolved_findings.recommendation: Retain explicit candidate status. For a later fidelity pass, use a source-supported environment composition that provides a transverse floor under the whole versus baseline, then recheck grounded actors at both edges.
resolved_findings.resolution: Image-generated replacement widens foreground with continuous horizontal carpet; desktop and mobile final screenshots show both actor feet on floor rather than plinth/wall.
